overall_summary: Analysis of THINK FAST DAILY performance data shows strong engagement with space, geography, and physics/history trivia challenges. Videos like 'Which Country Has The Most Lakes?' and 'Which Came First? 🧠 History Trivia Quiz!' achieved exceptional average view percentages (>100%) and solid view counts, while recent uploads suffered from zero views due to timing or lack of algorithmic pickup. Retention is highest when questions feature instantly understandable visual clues and strong curiosity gaps.

winning_patterns.evidence: 'Which Country Has The Most Lakes? 🌊 Geography Quiz!' reached 421 views and 66.91% average view percentage; 'What Color Is a Sunset on Mars? 🪐 Space Quiz!' reached 417 views and 51.68% average view percentage.
winning_patterns.action: Continue producing high-interest geography and space trivia quizzes with clear A/B/C/D choices.

winning_patterns.evidence: 'Which Came First? 🧠 History Trivia Quiz!' achieved 249 views and an extraordinary 135.81% average view percentage.
winning_patterns.action: Produce fresh chronological ordering and 'which came first' historical landmark challenges.

improvements.evidence: Recent shorts published on Sep 10 and Sep 11 ('Space fans, get this right!', 'One tiny clue gives it away!') recorded 0 views.
improvements.action: Align publish times strictly with proven high-performing traffic windows (UTC morning slots) and avoid erratic scheduling.

improvements.pattern: Low Retention on Complex Calendar / Word Trick Questions
improvements.evidence: 'Can You Solve This Calendar Trick Question? 🧠' dropped to 30.89% average view percentage.
improvements.action: Avoid overly convoluted calendar or wordplay trick questions that confuse viewers early; prioritize instant visual comprehension.

retention_insights.evidence: Audience watch ratio stayed above 1.8x at the start and remained high throughout the video (135.81% average view percentage).
retention_insights.action: Use strong historical comparison hooks that compel viewers to re-watch or pause to check facts.

retention_insights.video_pattern: Geography Quiz ('Which Country Has The Most Lakes?')
retention_insights.evidence: Initial watch ratio exceeded 1.23x with steady retention across the mid-point.
retention_insights.action: Start geography shorts immediately with the map or country options visible on screen during the hook.

best_posting_windows.reason: Observed on successful uploads like 'Which Country Has The Most Lakes?' (published at 06:45:45 UTC).
Observed on high-performing space quiz uploads like 'What Color Is a Sunset on Mars?' (published at 12:05:14 UTC).

next_best_quiz_directions.reason: Space quizzes consistently yield high watch percentages and subscriber conversion.
